U1.name: Unit I · Relations and Functions (8 marks)
U1.tip: Equivalence = reflexive + symmetric + transitive: check each with a pair. One-one: f(a) = f(b) ⇒ a = b; onto: every element of the codomain is hit. Principal ranges: sin⁻¹ [−π/2, π/2], cos⁻¹ [0, π], tan⁻¹ (−π/2, π/2).
U1.ncert: NCERT Mathematics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 1 Relations and Functions, Ch 2 Inverse Trigonometric Functions

U2.name: Unit II · Algebra (10 marks)
U2.tip: Skew-symmetric: Aᵀ = −A, so the diagonal is 0. For n × n: |kA| = kⁿ|A|, |adj A| = |A|ⁿ⁻¹. Solve AX = B by X = A⁻¹B (|A| ≠ 0). Idempotent A² = A simplifies powers.
U2.ncert: NCERT Mathematics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 3 Matrices, Ch 4 Determinants

U3.name: Unit III · Calculus (35 marks)
U3.tip: Continuity: LHL = RHL = f(a). Parametric dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt); log-differentiate xˣ. Increasing where f′ > 0. Maxima: f′ = 0 and f″ < 0. King's rule ∫₀ᵃ f(x) dx = ∫₀ᵃ f(a − x) dx; odd functions vanish on [−a, a]. Area = ∫ y dx. Linear DE: IF = e^∫P dx.
U3.ncert: NCERT Mathematics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 5 Continuity and Differentiability, Ch 6 Application of Derivatives, Ch 7 Integrals, Ch 8 Application of Integrals, Ch 9 Differential Equations

U4.name: Unit IV · Vectors and 3-D Geometry (14 marks)
U4.tip: Projection of a on b = a·b/|b|. |a × b| = area of the parallelogram. cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂|/(…). l² + m² + n² = 1. Shortest distance = |(a₂ − a₁)·(b₁ × b₂)|/|b₁ × b₂|. Planes are not in the 2026-27 list.
U4.ncert: NCERT Mathematics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 10 Vector Algebra, Ch 11 Three Dimensional Geometry

U5.name: Unit V · Linear Programming (5 marks)
U5.tip: Draw the constraints, list every corner point of the feasible region, evaluate Z at each; for an unbounded region check the open half-plane.
U5.ncert: NCERT Mathematics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 12 Linear Programming

U6.name: Unit VI · Probability (8 marks)
U6.tip: P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B). Independent: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B), so P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A)P(B). Bayes: P(Eᵢ|A) = P(Eᵢ)P(A|Eᵢ)/Σ P(Eⱼ)P(A|Eⱼ). Random variables are not in the 2026-27 list.
U6.ncert: NCERT Mathematics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 13 Probability

questions.question: How many equivalence relations on the set {1, 2, 3} contain both (1, 2) and (2, 1)?
questions.explanation: Such a relation must put 1 and 2 in one class. Either 3 is alone ({1, 2}, {3}) or with them (the universal relation): 2 relations.

questions.question: A is a square matrix with A² = A. Then (I + A)³ − 7A equals:
questions.explanation: (I + A)³ = I + 3A + 3A² + A³ = I + 3A + 3A + A = I + 7A, so the expression is I.

questions.question: f(x) = (x² − 9)/(x − 3) for x ≠ 3 and f(3) = k. Find k so that f is continuous at x = 3.
questions.explanation: For x ≠ 3, f(x) = x + 3 → 6 as x → 3. So k = 6.

questions.question: An open box is made from an 18 cm × 18 cm square sheet by cutting equal squares from the corners and folding up the sides. What is the maximum volume of the box, in cm³?
questions.explanation: V = s(18 − 2s)². V′ = 0 at s = 3 (s = 9 gives no box). V = 3 × 12 × 12 = 432 cm³.
